applicationStart:
cd code_deploy_application && npm ci && NODE_ENV=production npm run build
nohup npx --yes serve -s dist -l 8080 >> /root/application.log 2>&1 &
echo $! > /root/application.pid
applicationStop: if [ -f /root/application.pid ]; then kill $(cat /root/application.pid) || true; rm -f /root/application.pid; fi
